name: primary_condition_v4
status: proposed development reference for three datasets; not frozen
condition: learned reader (tied cosine + pairwise null + lexical overlap, stop list v1), stable observations, per-position delta writes (5 normalized adjoint steps, τ 0.1, A 0.3, v2 b_m), hard top-1 selection, null threshold 0.5, no cosine gate, binary write mass, top-k 4; R1-56 rare-token overlap gate: the query must share ≥ 1 non-stop token with the selected record's support prompt that occurs in ≤ 2 active records (rare_overlap_min=1, rare_df_max=2)
training: stream-scale mixed-domain episodes (64-record memories; CounterFact pool v1 + zsRE pool v1 + MQuAKE pool v2, 1,000 items each; 300 steps × 2; lr 1e-3; wd 0.01) plus 8 ordinary-text null queries per episode (512 OpenWebText training-range windows × prefix lengths 16/48/96, cap-off logits kept for the preservation KL; --text-nulls 8 --text-windows 512), scripts/r1_50_stream_train.py

development_results.mquake: RET-GS 0.79 / 0.68 / 0.56 (ES 0.92 / 1.00 / 1.00), LS 1.00; unseen false fires 0/100 at 100 records; drift +0.005 nats (pool-v1 reader)

controls: R1-nonlearned (random tied cosine reader + cosine gate 0.93 + per-position deltas)
teacher-only continuation (R1-24, pending the lead's variant decision)
open_risks: CounterFact selection among near-duplicate candidates at ≥ 1,000 records (fires-own 0.59–0.625 in the bank profile; P1/P3 profiles at 300/1,000 records on the real base in progress)
residual ordinary-text firing after CounterFact edits (+0.012 nats; the assay's fixed-length probes at 16/48/96 saw none, so the firing is at other prefix lengths)
unseen-edit-prompt false fires on zsRE 10 % at 1,000 records with the gate (rare relation words and subword fragments); 10–11 % over three seeds
